blocks.content: We'll first insert the vector elements into a heap. After insertion, the heap looks like this:
As the heap is heapified every time an element is inserted, our min-heap property is maintained.
2. Extract the minimum from the heap.
Since the root of the heap always contains the smallest element, we can simply extract the root repeatedly to get our elements in sorted order.
In this way, a heap can be used to efficiently sort elements in ascending or descending order using the heap sort algorithm.
